name: Agile CRM
label: Agile CRM — contacts, companies, deals
description: Official Agile CRM REST at https://{domain}.agilecrm.com/dev/api. Handler: OfficialApiNode. HTTP Basic (email + rest_api_key). Contacts vs companies share /api/contacts distinguished by type PERSON vs COMPANY. No public webhook subscribe API. Customer owns the Agile CRM domain. Credentials are never logged. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: Contact first name for contact.create. Example: Ada.

schema.label: type
schema.description: PERSON for contacts or COMPANY for company ops. Company create/update must send COMPANY.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Contact last name for contact.create. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email for contact.create. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Agile CRM properties array [{name, type: SYSTEM|CUSTOM, subtype, value}] for contact/company create/update. Example: [{"name":"email","value":"ada@example.com","type":"SYSTEM"}].

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Tag names for contact.create/update. JSON array of strings.

schema.label: lead_score
schema.description: Lead score integer for contact.create.

schema.label: star_value
schema.description: Star value 1–5 for contact.create / company.create.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Contact, company, or deal id.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Per-operation field `page_size`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Per-operation field `cursor`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: global_sort_key
schema.description: Per-operation field `global_sort_key`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Per-operation field `name`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: contact_ids
schema.description: Per-operation field `contact_ids`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: milestone
schema.description: Per-operation field `milestone`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: pipeline_id
schema.description: Track (pipeline) id of the deal on deal.create / deal.update; Agile CRM lists it as mandatory and milestone must belong to this track. Numeric id from Admin Settings > Deals > Tracks. Example: 5730082031140864.

schema.label: owner_id
schema.description: Id of the Agile CRM domain user who owns the deal on deal.create / deal.update (listed as mandatory by Agile CRM). Example: 6263975862861824.

schema.label: expected_value
schema.description: Per-operation field `expected_value`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: probability
schema.description: Per-operation field `probability`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: close_date
schema.description: Per-operation field `close_date`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | company.create | company.get | company.list | company.update | company.delete | deal.create | deal.get | deal.list | deal.update | deal.delete.

configurationParameters.label: Domain
configurationParameters.description: Subdomain label only (acme → https://acme.agilecrm.com). No scheme, no path. Shared production suffix is agilecrm.com.

configurationParameters.label: Email
configurationParameters.description: Agile user email (Basic username). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Rest Api Key
configurationParameters.description: REST client API key (Basic password). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
